result.brief: 提出"黑板智能"推理范式，用扩散语言模型的任意顺序预测接口在可修订画布上搜索解状态，以平均置信度引导推理时搜索与修正，在全局约束任务上超越自回归基线。
result.reason: Uses diffusion language models with any-order prediction and inference-time search over partially filled states, directly engaging continuous/diffusion language modeling and revisable latent canvases.
